watches.name: DS4 Solar Hiker - Topo Designs x W&W - Black
watches.description: SUMMARY: The DS4 Solar Hiker marks our first-ever triple-brand collaboration — a project that brings together Vaer, Topo Designs, and Worn & Wound to create something rugged, functional, and unmistakably unique. At its core, the Solar Hiker is an everyday adventure watch. It pairs a 39mm field-watch-inspired design with a 200m-rated dive case and a solar-powered movement, built to perform anywhere from the backcountry to the city. We’ve been longtime fans of Topo Designs — their heritage-inspired packs and outdoor gear have been part of our own adventures for years. Worn & Wound has also been a meaningful part of our story — we’ve worked alongside their team, had many of our watches reviewed on their site, and joined them at their iconic Windup Watch Fairs. This watch includes three straps total, as well as a custom Topo Collab Travel Pouch (Retail $39). The two default straps are single-pass, velco Topo straps in two distinct colors. The third strap is selected by the customer. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? The DS4 Solar Hiker is made for those who care about good gear — the kind that is reliable, durable, and doesn’t get in the way. With its compact size, 200m water resistance, and solar-powered movement, it’s just as capable on a trail or river as it is in the city. Whether you’re timing a hike, crossing time zones, or just keeping track of the day, the Solar Hiker is a tool you can count on — simple, durable, and ready for whatever’s next. INSPIRATION: The goal was to build a watch that’s functional without feeling fussy — legible day or night, resilient in any condition, and comfortable on every wrist. Every decision behind the Solar Hiker started with function. The 39mm case was chosen for comfort and balance. The solar-powered movement eliminates battery swaps, ensuring reliability off-grid. And the 200m-rated dive case means you’ll never have to take it off — rain, surf, or snow. We designed it to be tough, legible, and low-profile — a piece of gear that fits seamlessly into daily life. Built for the trail, tested for the water, and powered by the sun.

watches.name: C5 Postmaster - USPS Collab 40mm USA
watches.description: SUMMARY: Created in collaboration with the United States Postal Service, the C5 Postmaster is a classic American field watch that combines practical functionality with distinctive design. Powered by a reliable Swiss Ronda quartz movement, it introduces our first-ever day-date complication, displaying both the day of the week and date. As part of our bestselling C5 collection, this 40mm watch features a multi-layer navy dial, BGW9 Super-LumiNova, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, screw-down crown, 10 ATM water resistance, and full USA assembly. The result is a dependable everyday tool watch that celebrates over 250 years of American history. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? We recommend the C5 Postmaster for those seeking a versatile everyday watch that combines classic American styling with modern durability. Its accurate quartz movement and practical day-date function make it an ideal choice for daily wear, while the 40mm stainless steel case offers a comfortable, balanced fit for most wrists. With its distinctive USPS-inspired design, the Postmaster will also appeal to collectors, field-watch enthusiasts, and those who appreciate American heritage and craftsmanship. INSPIRATION: In designing the C5 Postmaster, our goal was to pay tribute to the United States Postal Service, an American institution that has connected communities for over 250 years. The collaboration is particularly meaningful to Vaer, as USPS has been a trusted shipping partner since our founding in 2016. Inspired by classic American field watches and the Postal Service's visual heritage, the Postmaster features a distinctive navy dial with carefully considered USPS-inspired details, a durable steel case, and a practical day-date display. The result combines timeless utility with modern watchmaking, celebrating a shared commitment to reliability, service, and American craftsmanship.

watches.name: R1 Oceanracer Chronograph Cream - 42mm USA
watches.description: Inspired by the design, spirit, and durability of the iconic racing watches of the 1960s and 1970s, the R1 Oceanracer blends vintage motorsport aesthetics with the rugged capability our brand is known for. Combining the timeless appeal of a classic racing chronograph with genuine everyday functionality, it's built as a sports watch without compromise. Built around a 42mm case, the R1 Oceanracer features a fixed ceramic tachymeter bezel, a dimensional multi-layer dial, refined chronograph pushers, and an elevated mix of brushed and polished finishes throughout. Every visible component has been carefully executed to deliver the look and feel of a premium sports chronograph while maintaining the accessible value that defines Vaer. Powering the watch is the proven Seiko VK63 meca-quartz movement, combining quartz accuracy with the satisfying tactile feel of a mechanical chronograph. Assembled in the USA, the R1 Oceanracer also features a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, locking screw-down crown, and is backed by Vaer's Guaranteed Waterproof Warranty—making it one of the few chronographs built for genuine everyday ocean use. Offered in both a classic black configuration and a distinctive cream dial with orange accents, the R1 Oceanracer delivers a refined interpretation of the modern sports chronograph while remaining true to Vaer's commitment to functional, adventure-ready design. Uniquely positioned as a USA-assembled chronograph designed for life on land and in the water, it offers a compelling blend of independent American craftsmanship, premium execution, and everyday versatility.

watches.name: A4 Tactical Field DLC Auto - 41.5mm USA
watches.description: SUMMARY: The A4 Tactical brings the same rugged field-ready design as the C4 Tactical, now powered by a premium automatic movement. Built around a reliable Japanese Miyota 9015 caliber, it combines the heritage and character of a mechanical watch with uncompromising durability: a bead-blasted steel case, recessed 4 o'clock crown, 200 meters of water resistance, and the brightest lume we've ever produced with 3D Super-LumiNova blocks. Designed for those who appreciate the craftsmanship of an automatic movement, the A4 delivers military-inspired functionality with the enduring appeal of traditional watchmaking. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? We recommend the A4 for enthusiasts who appreciate the ritual and craftsmanship of a mechanical watch but refuse to compromise on durability. It offers the same rugged capabilities as the C4 Tactical while delivering the smooth sweep and self-winding operation that automatic collectors prefer. At 41.5mm, the A4 has a confident wrist presence, while its ergonomic case profile and recessed crown ensure lasting comfort during extended wear. Whether you're in the field, traveling, or simply looking for a dependable everyday companion, the A4 is built to perform for decades to come. INSPIRATION: The A4 Tactical draws inspiration from the legendary Benrus Type I — the stripped-down military-issued diver developed for Navy SEALs and covert operatives during the 1970s. Every design decision reflects that same form-follows-function philosophy: matte bead-blasted surfaces to reduce reflections, oversized syringe hands for instant legibility, and bold military numerals inspired by classic U.S. Air Force stencils. While remaining faithful to the spirit of the original, the A4 answers years of customer demand for a mechanical version of the C4 Tactical, pairing timeless automatic watchmaking with the uncompromising performance expected from a modern field watch.

watches.description: SUMMARY The G2 Fairway GMT is a golf–inspired 15ATM GMT watch that offers a more affordable entry into Vaer’s GMT USA-assembled lineup. Powered by a Swiss Ronda quartz GMT movement, this model ensures precision timekeeping across multiple time zones, making it a reliable and cost-effective alternative to the G5 Meridian automatic. With its quartz movement, the G2 provides exceptional accuracy and low-maintenance reliability for frequent travelers. Built on the brand’s steel-bezel GMT platform, the Fairway reinterprets that architecture through a golf-specific lens — not as a novelty, but as a functional extension of the watch. The familiar 24-position system is adapted into an analog scoring reference, allowing golfers to track their round without interrupting the rhythm of play. The result is a watch that blends two worlds: a restrained, field-inspired GMT rooted in vintage design language, and a purpose-built tool for the course.

watches.name: G2 Apocalypse GMT - 39mm USA
watches.description: SUMMARY The G2 Apocalypse GMT is a 1970s cinema–inspired 15ATM GMT watch that offers a more affordable entry into Vaer’s GMT USA-assembled lineup. Powered by a Swiss Ronda quartz GMT movement, this model ensures precision timekeeping across multiple time zones, making it a reliable and cost-effective alternative to the G5 Meridian automatic. The watch features a 39mm brushed stainless steel case, a fixed radial-brushed steel bezel, and a sapphire crystal, combining durability with everyday practicality. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? The G2 Apocalypse GMT is ideal for those seeking a distinctive, travel-ready GMT watch at a more accessible price point. With its quartz movement, the G2 provides exceptional accuracy and low-maintenance reliability for frequent travelers. Its 39mm case size fits comfortably on most wrists, while the stripped-bezel design offers a versatile, understated aesthetic that stands apart from traditional bi-color GMTs. INSPIRATION The G2 Apocalypse GMT draws inspiration from one of the most recognizable cinematic GMTs of the 1970s — the Rolex GMT-Master worn by Marlon Brando in Apocalypse Now . Unlike traditional travel watches of the era, that reference removed the signature bi-color bezel insert, resulting in a more restrained and unconventional silhouette. Our interpretation preserves that stripped-back visual language while restoring full GMT functionality. A fixed radial-brushed steel bezel replaces the traditional rotating insert, subtly reshaping the watch’s proportions and highlighting the twisted lug architecture and external crown guard. Rectangular 24-hour markers are integrated along the dial perimeter, maintaining clear second-time-zone tracking without reintroducing a conventional bezel. The result is a fully functional GMT that blends field-watch restraint with travel-watch capability — rooted in 1970s cultural context, yet built for daily wear.

We recommend the D4 for those seeking a dependable ocean-oriented tool watch that can also be dressed up for more formal occasions. The perpetual timekeeping function of a solar-powered quartz watch makes it the perfect fit for an everyday wearer, and the choice of 39mm case sizing provides an option for most men's wrists while also maintaining our commitment to ergonomic, and timeless proportions. INSPIRATION: In designing the D4 Meridian our goal was to pay homage to the history of military dive watches while also further establishing a distinct and modern Vaer aesthetic. This watch's dial design and bezel are inspired by Rolex and Doxa military divers from the 1970s - and the case is inspired by the military issue Omega Seamaster. The D4 Meridian Solar is further distinguished as one of the first Vaer field watches powered by ambient light - a premium feature that optimizes its use in remote settings and helps deliver on the promise of near-perpetual timekeeping.

watches.name: DS4 Topo Designs x W&W Solar Hiker - Green
watches.description: SUMMARY: The DS4 Solar Hiker marks our first-ever triple-brand collaboration — a project that brings together Vaer, Topo Designs, and Worn & Wound to create something rugged, functional, and unmistakably unique. At its core, the Solar Hiker is an everyday adventure watch. It pairs a 38mm field-watch-inspired design with a 200m-rated dive case and a solar-powered movement, built to perform anywhere from the backcountry to the city. We’ve been longtime fans of Topo Designs — their heritage-inspired packs and outdoor gear have been part of our own adventures for years. Worn & Wound has also been a meaningful part of our story — we’ve worked alongside their team, had many of our watches reviewed on their site, and joined them at their iconic Windup Watch Fairs. This watch includes three straps total, as well as a custom Topo Collab Travel Pouch (Retail $39). The two default straps are single-pass, velco Topo straps in two distinct colors. The third strap is selected by the customer. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? The DS4 Solar Hiker is made for those who care about good gear — the kind that is reliable, durable, and doesn’t get in the way. With its compact size, 200m water resistance, and solar-powered movement, it’s just as capable on a trail or river as it is in the city. Whether you’re timing a hike, crossing time zones, or just keeping track of the day, the Solar Hiker is a tool you can count on — simple, durable, and ready for whatever’s next. INSPIRATION: The goal was to build a watch that’s functional without feeling fussy — legible day or night, resilient in any condition, and comfortable on every wrist. Every decision behind the Solar Hiker started with function. The 38mm case was chosen for comfort and balance. The solar-powered movement eliminates battery swaps, ensuring reliability off-grid. And the 200m-rated dive case means you’ll never have to take it off — rain, surf, or snow. We designed it to be tough, legible, and low-profile — a piece of gear that fits seamlessly into daily life. Built for the trail, tested for the water, and powered by the sun.

watches.name: S5 Dirty Dozen - 40mm Quartz
watches.description: SUMMARY: This is the new quartz-powered version of our military-inspired A12 Dirty Dozen field watch, which was first introduced into the Vaer lineup in 2019. The watch is powered by a reliable Japanese quartz movement and protected by a flat sapphire crystal—delivering maintenance-free performance in the harshest conditions. With a screwdown crown, 100 meters of water resistance, and interchangeable straps (including our waterproof quick-change options), this is a true all-terrain timepiece—ready for everything. As an S5 model, this watch is part of our affordable Standard Issue collection, distinguished by its ocean-ready functionality, low-profile case design, ultra-accurate quartz movement, and entry-level price point. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? We recommend the S5 for those seeking a dependable tool watch that can also be dressed up for more formal occasions. The "set-it-and-forget-it" nature of quartz makes it the perfect fit for an everyday wearer, and the 36mm case sizing is great option for those with smaller wrists, or who prefer a more vintage on-wrist presence reminiscent of the 1950s and 1960s. INSPIRATION: In building the S5 Dirty Dozen, our goal is to return this iconic military field watch to its original use case: a rugged, accurate ocean-proof timekeeper. If quartz technology had existed in 1939 when the original models were being commissioned, it definitely would have been the choice of military commanders. If you’ve always appreciated the design and story of the Dirty Dozen, but prefer the functional superiority of quartz, we think that this watch delivers the perfect all-in-one solution.

watches.name: C4 Tactical Field DLC Solar - 41.5mm USA
watches.description: SUMMARY: The C4 Tactical is the most rugged solar-powered watch we’ve ever built — designed from the ground up as a true operator’s tool. It combines uncompromising durability with modern technology: a bead-blasted steel case, recessed 4 o’clock crown, 200 meters of water resistance, and the brightest lume we’ve ever produced with 3D Super-LumiNova blocks. Like all our solar models, six hours of light delivers up to six months of reserve, and it can charge off any light source, even candlelight. Unlike the sleeker C5 Tactical, the C4 is larger, more aggressive, and purpose-built for field use — making it the toughest tool watch in the Vaer lineup. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? We recommend the C4 for those who need maximum toughness and legibility — whether that’s military service, first responders, outdoor professionals, or anyone who demands gear that performs under pressure. At 41.5mm, the C4 has real wrist presence, while its ergonomic case lines and flush crown ensure comfort even under heavy use or layered gear. This is a watch designed first and foremost as equipment, but it transitions seamlessly into daily wear for anyone who values rugged authenticity. INSPIRATION: The C4 was inspired by the legendary Benrus Type I — the stripped-down, military-issued diver built for Navy SEALs and covert operatives in the 1970s. That same form-follows-function ethos defines the C4: matte bead-blasted surfaces to kill reflections, oversized syringe hands for quick readability, and bold military numerals based on U.S. Air Force stencils. By swapping mechanical movements for solar technology, we’ve delivered greater accuracy, reliability, and zero-maintenance operation, while still honoring the DNA of the original. The C4 Tactical carries forward the heritage of military tool watches while establishing a new standard for modern performance.

watches.name: G5 Pacific Polar GMT - 39mm USA
watches.description: SUMMARY The G5 Pacific is a 1950s-inspired 20ATM automatic watch that stands out in the Vaer line-up as our most premium USA-assembled model and our second automatic GMT. As a G-series model, this watch is part of our dual timezone automatic series, distinguished by its ocean-ready functionality, self-winding movement, and full American assembly. WHO IS THIS WATCH FOR? We recommend the G5 for those seeking a premium automatic dual-timezone watch that references the very best GMTs in history. The timeless nature of mechanical movements makes it the perfect fit for an everyday wearer, and the 39mm case sizing is large enough to command presence on most men's wrists while still maintaining our commitment to ergonomic, and timeless proportions. INSPIRATION The G5 Pacific is the GMT version of the Pacific diver (our core dive watch design). In designing that watch, our goal was to pay homage to military history while also further establishing a distinct and modern Vaer aesthetic. This watch's dial design is inspired by the 1971 Rolex Explorer II ref. 1655 and 1950s GMT Master, worn by American Pan Am pilots in the early days of commercial aviation. The dial features Vaer’s distinctive curved trapezoid indices (another hallmark of Vaer dials). The G5 GMT is further distinguished as one of the first Vaer model to use Grade A Old Radium lume paint - the feature that helps it achieve such an incredible night-time glow.
